name: THE X-PLORATOR
description: A serene cosmic exploration game. Fly a small white explorer through the blue-violet Outer Verge beneath a giant luminous planet: scan crystal asteroids, collect Cryon and Ferrite, return to Haven Outpost, upgrade your ship's modules in the hangar and grow a hexagonal orbital base. One-stick flight with auto-cruise, keyboard, controller and touch. M1 prototype.

credits.work: THE X-PLORATOR game code, procedural ship, planet, sky, station and interface
credits.by: Original work created for THE X-PLORATOR, all geometry and shaders generated in code
